key_insight: The paper connects data-driven and theoretical turbulence closures to better represent unresolved mesoscale eddies in stratified ocean flows.
engineering_relevance: Improved closure models can make ocean simulations more accurate and computationally feasible for predicting momentum, energy, and tracer transport.
method: Compare theoretical and AI/data-driven mesoscale closure models
Use analytical tools to identify relationships between closure formulations
Evaluate how closures represent inverse energy cascade behavior in stratified Boussinesq flows
evidence_signal: The abstract describes an exploratory study that examines a range of closures and their connections using analytical and data-driven methods, but does not report quantitative performance results.
watch_item: Data-driven closures may fit specific training regimes yet fail to generalize across ocean conditions or preserve key physical constraints.
paper_title: Towards bridging the gap between data-driven and theoretical turbulence closures in stratified flows
